note: Windows lvkit staging image bound to the dev-tools PRERELEASE tag devtools-v2.2.1 (schema vi-history-suite/devtools-release@v1, contentDigest above, built from prototype's compiled out/ at gitCommit). Build via prototype/lvkit-stage-win.Dockerfile in CI (the local Docker Desktop Windows builder has no DNS); tag + run the container after the dev-tools tag: vihs-lvkit-stage-win:devtools-v2.2.1.
